description: Lot GA3-L1 : décor 3D de bataille généré (image flux-2 → détourage bria → TRELLIS sur fal.ai → `tools/blender_scripts/ga3_cleanup.py`). Chaque objet donne son prompt, sa taille réelle, son plafond de triangles et le type du kit qu'il remplace en partie (`kit_kind`, `share`). Les glb vont dans `game/assets/models/props_ga/` avec `manifest.json` (généré : emprise mesurée, triangles). `wired: false` = généré mais non branché (modèle procédural ou animé gardé). ADR 0140.
style_prefix: Photorealistic matte-painted reference photograph of a single
style_suffix: Rural medieval France circa 1340, humble, heavily weathered and slightly irregular, hand-made natural materials (oak, lime plaster, fieldstone, thatch, hand-forged iron), real material scale and proportions, visible wear, moss, grime and mud at the base, no brick, no glass, no sheet metal, no modern elements, no text, no people, no animals. Muted earthy colour palette, low saturation, natural desaturated tones (greys, browns, ochres, olive greens), albedo like an overcast day, no neon, no bright primary colours. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object fully visible, centred and filling about 85 percent of the frame, on a plain uniform medium grey studio background, no ground, no grass, no plants, no terrain, no base, no cast shadow on the floor, soft even diffuse overcast light, no baked directional shadow, no reflections, sharp realistic material detail, physically based look.

objects.label: Maison paysanne à pans de bois et chaume
objects.prompt: small 14th-century French peasant cottage, one storey only with a low attic under the roof, walls of lime-washed wattle and daub infill between exposed weathered dark oak timber framing, steep roof of very thick old straw thatch that is dark grey-brown and weathered, darkened by years of rain and smoke, the thatch smooth, dense and evenly combed with a uniform surface and thick rounded eaves, a plain ridge, a small smoke hole in the thatch near the ridge and no chimney, one low plank door with iron strap hinges, one small unglazed window with a wooden shutter, low rubble fieldstone sill wall at the foot of the walls.
objects.note: L1b : chaume regénéré sombre et lisse (le chaume S4 sortait blanchi et bosselé), étalonnage `auto_levels` 0,2 (au lieu de 0,5 : moins d'écrêtage vers le blanc) et `gamma` 1,15 (albédo moyen 0,17 sinon, chaume dominant).

objects.label: Église de village
objects.prompt: small 14th-century French Romanesque-Gothic village church, rough limestone rubble walls with dressed stone quoins, long single nave with a steep grey slate roof, a square stone bell tower at the west end with a short pyramidal slate spire, a round-arched west portal with a plain wooden door, narrow lancet windows without glass, small semicircular apse at the east end.

objects.label: Moulin à vent sur pivot
objects.prompt: medieval wooden post mill windmill, a boxy weathered oak plank body with a gabled wooden roof raised on a single massive central post braced by four diagonal timber quarterbars on crossed trestle beams, a long wooden tail pole and a small ladder at the back, four large lattice sails of wooden frames with furled canvas, the sails turned sideways to the viewer.

objects.label: Tente de campagne
objects.prompt: 14th-century military campaign tent, a ridge tent of undyed heavy linen canvas stretched over two wooden poles and a ridge pole, walls tied down with hemp guy ropes to short wooden pegs, the front flap tied open, stained and patched canvas.

objects.label: Palissade (segment)
objects.prompt: straight segment of a medieval field palisade, a single row of about ten sharpened rough wooden stakes of equal height driven close together, slightly leaning, lashed to two horizontal split rails, bark still on some stakes, seen from the side.
objects.note: trellis/multi essayé (3 vues) : un peu plus de débris que la vue unique, gardée. Pieux ramenés à 1,9 m (palissade basse du cœur : 1,7 m).

objects.label: Puits
objects.prompt: medieval village well, a round low wall of rough fieldstone blocks, two wooden posts carrying a crossbeam with a wooden windlass and crank, a hemp rope and a wooden bucket bound with iron hoops, a small pitched roof of dark weathered brown oak shingles over the windlass, the roof dark and wooden like the posts.
objects.note: L1b : toit en bardeaux de chêne sombres (le toit L1 sortait blanchi).

objects.label: Charrette
objects.prompt: medieval two-wheeled farm cart, a plank bed with low slatted wooden sides, two long shafts in front, two large spoked wooden wheels with iron tyres, weathered grey oak, empty.
objects.note: trellis/multi essayé (3 vues flux-2 edit) : débris à l'arrière ; la vue unique est plus propre, gardée.

objects.label: Trébuchet
objects.prompt: medieval counterweight trebuchet, a heavy oak timber A-frame on a rectangular base of beams, a long throwing arm pivoting on an axle, a big wooden box counterweight filled with stones at the short end, a rope sling hanging from the long end, iron bands, rope lashings.
objects.note: Vue unique et trellis/multi équivalentes (un seul îlot) ; pas dans le kit du décor (`wired` faux) ; L5 : découpé en pièces animées (bâti, verge, caisse) par `ga3_siege_rig.py` → `siege/ga3_trebuchet.glb`, posé par `SiegeEnginesFx` (ADR 0140 § L5).

objects.label: Bélier couvert
objects.prompt: medieval covered battering ram, a long tree-trunk ram with an iron cap hung by chains inside a low wheeled wooden gallery, the pitched roof of the gallery made of thick dark weathered oak planks covered with wet dark brown leather hides of one plain uniform colour, four solid wooden wheels, heavy oak frame.
objects.note: L1b : toit en planches couvertes de peaux brunes unies (peaux L1 « vache pie »), vue unique TRELLIS. L5 : découpé (abri, roues, poutre) par `ga3_siege_rig.py` → `siege/ga3_ram.glb`, posé par `SiegeEnginesFx` (ADR 0140 § L5).
